title: Pick a speciality, or get both
intro: Brand identity, UX/UI design, or the whole journey from logo to launched website. Every project starts with a free 20-minute call.

services.title: Brand identity
services.summary: A mark people remember and a system that holds up everywhere, from a WhatsApp profile picture to a highway billboard.

services.title: UX/UI & digital
services.summary: Research-led websites and apps that feel calm to use, tested with real people before a line of code is written.

services.title: Brand + digital
services.summary: The whole journey. One team takes you from first sketch to launched website, so the brand and the product never drift apart.

included.title: Fixed quote upfront
included.body: You know the price before we start. No hourly surprises.

included.title: Milestone check-ins
included.body: A short review at the end of every stage, with both founders.

included.title: Two revision rounds
included.body: Per stage, built into the timeline and the quote.

included.title: Files you own
included.body: Source files, brand guide and Figma handover. Yours to keep.

faq_title: Good to know before we talk

faq.q: Can we hire just one of you?
faq.a: Yes. Identity-only and digital-only projects each have one lead designer, and the other founder still reviews the work, at no extra cost.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Canada?
faq.a: Yes. We're based in the Greater Toronto Area and already work with businesses in India and beyond, remotely or in person.
A fixed quote, split into a deposit to start and payments at agreed milestones.

faq.q: What do you need from us to start?
faq.a: A 20-minute call, any existing brand files, and one person on your side who can make decisions.
